turns.utterance: Mount the graduated focal test sample in the marking fixture at the nominal standoff distance. ground_truth.node_text: Mount the graduated focal test sample in the marking fixture at the nominal standoff distance. Mark a line across the full graduation range while stepping focus in 0.5 millimetre increments per segment. Inspect the marked line under a magnifier and identify the segment with the narrowest, cleanest line width; record the corresponding focus offset and compare against the value stored in the machine setup parameter table.
